Rounds the values of a numeric field of a vector to the decimals of a pattern.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Round, Vector, Attributes<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorFieldRounder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector of which to round a numeric value. |
| `fRound` | String |  |  | The numeric field to round. |
| `pPattern` | String |  |  | The rounding pattern, as 0.00 for two decimals. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outVector` | output file |  | The modified vector. |
